stem: Five emitters deliver 100, 101, 99, 100 and 80 mL during the same timed test. Which finding is most important?
choices: One emitter is a clear low-output outlier requiring investigation
The average proves every root zone received 96 mL
The test cannot reveal distribution differences
rationale: The 80 mL emitter is a meaningful localized delivery outlier even though the group average masks some of the difference.
